description: Final MATH316 validation; legacy runtime, unequal budgets. Full GSM curves remain in the archived figures.
Same saved evaluation budget; selected RL checkpoints and unequal training histories. Critical depth is not physical parallel speedup.
All500 denominator. The step50 point is a different training campaign and is not a paired training ablation.
RL hybrid protocol: 77 completed4k traces plus rerun53 at32k; native130 fresh BF16 vLLM. No exact-compute comparison.
Raw saved telemetry. Repeated steps use last saved row. Rank loss is an arithmetic rank mean; local seconds is max rank duration, not instrumented global step time.
